children: Apple is considering changes to Safari on iPhone Duo so webpages can use more of the outer display, but has not finalized a plan. According to Sina Finance, Apple engineer Jen Simmons said in an October 23 WebKit blog post that the existing “viewport-fit=cover” setting lets webpages extend beneath Safari’s side controls, but Apple found that many websites do not support it properly. Developers must leave safe margins around core content to prevent it from being obscured, and Simmons said most websites have not adapted for all screen edges. Apple is exploring another approach that would give developers more control while reducing the risk of content being obscured, such as allowing a webpage’s header background to fill the screen while keeping navigation links in an unobstructed area.

title: Apple Considers Expanding Safari Across iPhone Duo’s Outer Display
